entry_signal: Close > MA200 (daily). Optional: ADX(14) > 20 for trend confirmation.
exit: Trailing stop: 3xATR(14) from highest close since entry. Hard stop: close < MA200 (regime flip).
sizing: Fixed fractional: risk = 1.5% of equity per trade. Units = (equity * risk_pct) / (3 * ATR * point_value).
filter: ADX(14) > 20 to skip chop; trade only in direction of MA200 slope (slope > 0 for longs).
backtest_ref: GC=F MA200_HK baseline ~9.5% CAGR / 33.6% DD (ground truth).
notes: User's proven style. Baseline already established. Candidate variants: (a) ADX filter to cut whipsaw, (b) Weekly timeframe for lower DD, (c) SPY/N225 cross-asset expansion. Weekly GC=F expected to reduce DD by ~30-40% vs daily at cost of fewer trades.

entry_signal: Weekly close > MA200 (weekly). ADX(14) > 25 on weekly chart.
exit: 3xATR(14) trailing on weekly closes. Flip to cash when close < MA200.
sizing: Equal-risk across all qualifying assets. Risk = 1.0% equity per asset per week.
filter: ADX(14) > 25 weekly; MA200 slope positive. Max 3 concurrent positions.
backtest_ref: GC=F daily MA200 baseline ~9.5% CAGR / 33.6% DD; weekly expected ~8-10% CAGR / 22-28% DD.
notes: Reduces trade frequency and DD at cost of lag. SPY baseline ~10.8%/37% DD. Diversification across GC=F+SPY+N225 should improve Sharpe via low cross-correlation. Good fit for user's conservative post-recovery stance.

entry_signal: Close > MA200 AND ADX(14) > 25 AND MA200 slope > 0.
exit: Trailing 3xATR. Hard exit when ADX drops below 20 OR close < MA200.
sizing: 1.0% risk per trade. Volatility-adjusted: units scale with ATR.
filter: Triple gate: price > MA200, ADX > 25, MA200 slope positive. Eliminates ~40% of trades but targets higher-quality setups.
backtest_ref: GC=F MA200 baseline ~9.5% CAGR / 33.6% DD; ADX filter expected to reduce DD to ~25-28% CAGR ~8-9%.
notes: Strict regime filter. Sacrifices return for lower DD — aligns with user's post-recovery risk tolerance. Best compared against baseline to quantify the DD-reduction/return-sacrifice tradeoff.

entry_signal: Close > 20-day Donchian high (breakout above prior 20-day range). ADX(14) > 25 required.
exit: Trailing 2xATR(14). Alternatively: exit on close below 10-day Donchian low.
sizing: 1.0% risk per trade. Volatility-scaled via ATR.
filter: ADX(14) > 25 to confirm breakout has trend strength. Skip if ATR > 2x its 50-day median (avoid volatility expansion entries).
backtest_ref: GC=F MA200 baseline ~9.5% CAGR / 33.6% DD; Donchian20 expected ~10-12% CAGR / 28-35% DD (whipsaw risk).
notes: User's second proven style. Donchian20 is classic Turtle-style breakout. ADX filter is critical — raw Donchian20 on GC=F has high whipsaw rate. SPY baseline ~10.8%/37% DD; N225 higher vol. Cross-asset diversification recommended.

entry_signal: Weekly close > 20-week Donchian high. Weekly ATR expansion confirmed.
exit: Trailing 3xATR(14) on weekly closes. Exit when close < 10-week Donchian low.
sizing: 1.0% risk per trade per asset. Max 2 concurrent.
filter: Weekly ADX > 25; 20-week Donchian width > 1.5x its 50-week median (avoids tight-range false breakouts).
backtest_ref: GC=F daily Donchian20 baseline; weekly expected ~9-11% CAGR / 22-28% DD.
notes: Weekly breakout reduces noise significantly. Fewer trades, larger moves. Fits barbell's aggressive end with better DD profile than daily.

strategy: BB/RSI Oversold against MA200 Regime (Long Only)
entry_signal: Price > MA200 (regime filter, longs only). RSI(14) < 30 OR close < lower Bollinger Band (20,2). Reversal candle confirmation.
exit: Target: reversion to MA200 or RSI(14) > 60. Stop: close < MA200 (regime break) or 1.5xATR adverse.
sizing: 0.75% risk per trade (smaller — mean-reversion has higher win rate but fat tails).
filter: Only enter longs when price > MA200. No shorting. BB width > median (avoid extreme compression).
backtest_ref: GC=F ~14.6% ann vol; SPY ~10-12% ann vol. Mean-reversion within trend expected ~7-9% CAGR / 15-22% DD.
notes: Counter-trend within the MA200 trend regime. Buys dips in uptrends. Smaller risk per trade due to tail risk (catching falling knives). Complements trend-following core. Best as sub-strategy within barbell.

entry_signal: Bullish RSI divergence: price makes lower low, RSI(14) makes higher low, while price > MA200 (trend context).
exit: Target: previous swing high or RSI(14) > 55. Stop: 1.5xATR below entry or close < MA200.
sizing: 0.5% risk per trade (smallest — divergence fades are low-probability, high-payoff).
filter: Price must be > MA200. RSI divergence must span at least 10 bars. Volume confirmation on reversal candle.
backtest_ref: GC=F MA200 baseline; divergence fade expected ~6-8% CAGR / 12-18% DD.
notes: High-selectivity, low-frequency. Good as a tactical overlay — deploys capital when trend strategies are flat. Lower risk due to low win rate.

entry_signal: Long GC=F only when DXY < 50d MA (gold-favorable regime) AND ADX(14) > 20. Price > MA200 confirmation.
exit: 3xATR trailing. Flip to cash when DXY > 50d MA OR close < MA200.
sizing: 1.5% risk per trade. Volatility-scaled.
filter: DXY regime gate is primary. ADX > 20 secondary. No trade when DXY flat (within 1% of 50d MA).
backtest_ref: DXY-gated gold ~51% CAGR / 19% DD (strong ground truth). Expected realized ~12-18% CAGR / 18-25% DD after trading costs/slippage.
notes: Strongest ground-truth candidate. DXY inversion as gold driver is well-established. The 51% CAGR figure is from a cleaner regime filter; real-world execution will be lower but should still beat MA200 baseline. DXY is available on most FX platforms via DXY index or USD index.

entry_signal: IF DXY < 50d MA AND DXY slope < 0 → Long GC=F. IF DXY > 50d MA AND DXY slope > 0 → Long USDJPY. IF ADX(14) < 15 across all → cash.
exit: 3xATR trailing per asset. Regime flip signal triggers exit and re-entry in opposite asset.
sizing: 1.0% risk per active position. Max 1 position at a time (full conviction switch).
filter: DXY slope + level. ADX(14) > 15 for any position. No-trade zone when DXY within 0.5% of 50d MA.
backtest_ref: DXY-gated gold ~51% CAGR/19% DD; USDJPY ~10.1% vol; combined expected ~12-16% CAGR / 16-22% DD.
notes: Dynamic switching between gold and yen based on dollar regime. Capitalizes on the inverse DXY/gold and DXY/USDJPY relationships. Simplest version is DXY-gated gold alone (CAND-08); this adds the USDJPY leg for when dollar is strong. Higher complexity, potential for regime-whipsaw losses.

entry_signal: GC=F price > MA200 AND GC=F MA200 slope positive (calculated on log-price linear regression). DXY < 50d MA as confirmation.
exit: Trailing 3xATR. Exit when GC=F MA200 slope turns negative.
sizing: 1.5% risk per trade.
filter: MA200 slope must be > 0 (computed as angle of regression over past 200 daily closes). DXY filter optional confirmation.
backtest_ref: GC=F MA200 baseline ~9.5% CAGR / 33.6% DD; slope-filtered expected ~10-12% CAGR / 25-30% DD.
notes: Refines MA200 by adding slope direction — avoids entering when MA200 is flat (transition regimes). Simple, interpretable. Good complement to DXY gate (CAND-08) — use slope as primary, DXY as secondary.

entry_signal: Price > MA200 (regime gate). Position sized to target 10% annualized vol.
exit: Trailing 2xATR. Regime flip (close < MA200) exits entirely.
sizing: Position size = (equity * target_vol) / realized_vol. realized_vol = annualized 30-day ATR. Rebalance weekly. Leverage cap at 2x.
risk_per_trade: Vol-targeted (not fixed %); effective risk varies with market vol.
filter: MA200 regime gate. If realized_vol > 20% annualized, scale down (no leverage). If < 8%, scale up to target.
backtest_ref: GC=F ~14.6% ann vol; targeting 10% vol implies ~0.68x leverage on baseline. Expected ~7-9% CAGR / 10-14% DD.
notes: Vol targeting smooths returns and caps DD. GC=F at 14.6% vol targeting 10% means ~30% position reduction from full notional. Lower DD but also lower CAGR. Best as the 'safe end' of the aggressive barbell — stable, predictable risk.

entry_signal: Each asset independently: price > MA200. Portfolio-level vol target.
exit: Trailing 2xATR per asset. Asset exits independently; portfolio vol rebalanced weekly.
sizing: Portfolio vol = sqrt(w1^2*v1^2 + w2^2*v2^2 + 2*r*w1*w2*v1*v2). Solve weights to hit 12% annualized portfolio vol. Max weight 60% per asset.
filter: MA200 regime per asset. Cash allocated when no asset qualifies (reduces portfolio vol).
backtest_ref: GC=F ~14.6% vol, SPY ~10-12% vol, correlation ~0.2-0.4. Expected ~9-11% CAGR / 11-16% DD.
notes: Diversified vol target. Low correlation between GC=F and SPY means efficient vol frontier. Expected to hit 12% vol with smaller DD than any single asset. Good core holding for barbell.

entry_signal: Same as CAND-12.
exit: Same as CAND-12.
sizing: 12% target vol with leverage up to 1.5x. During high vol (>18% realized), deleverage to 0.5x target.
filter: MA200 regime per asset. Dynamic leverage multiplier based on VIX/realized vol regime.
backtest_ref: Expected ~11-14% CAGR / 13-18% DD (leverage amplifies returns in low-vol regimes).
notes: Adds dynamic leverage — borrows in low-vol regimes to hit target, deleverages in high-vol. Can boost CAGR but adds tail risk from leverage in sudden vol spikes. Requires margin account (IBKR supports this).

entry_signal: Rank assets by composite momentum: 0.5 * 1M return + 0.5 * 3M return. Go long top-2 ranked assets.
exit: Rebalance monthly. Exit any asset that drops out of top-2. Trailing 2xATR stop on each position.
sizing: Equal-weight among selected assets. Each at 1.0% risk per month.
filter: All assets must be > MA200 (trend filter). Skip assets with ADX(14) < 15.
backtest_ref: Individual asset baselines: GC=F ~9.5%/33.6% DD, USDJPY ~10.1% vol. Momentum rotation expected ~10-14% CAGR / 18-26% DD.
notes: Classic momentum rotation across FX and commodities. XAU and USDJPY often have negative correlation (good for diversification). EURUSD adds carry dimension. A50 adds equity-beta dimension. Monthly rebalancing balances signal persistence vs turnover.

entry_signal: Composite 1M+3M momentum rank. Select top-3 assets with ADX > 20.
exit: Monthly rebalance. Trailing 2xATR per position.
sizing: Inverse-vol weighting: weight_i = (1/vol_i) / sum(1/vol_j) for selected assets. Cap any single asset at 40%.
filter: ADX > 20 and price > MA200 for each asset. Minimum 2 assets selected; else go to cash.
backtest_ref: Expected ~10-13% CAGR / 15-22% DD (inverse-vol smoothing).
notes: Refinement of CAND-14: instead of equal-weight, weights by inverse volatility for more stable portfolio DD. Better risk-adjusted returns than equal-weight momentum.

entry_signal: Short GC=F when: (a) RSI(14) > 75 with bearish divergence (price higher high, RSI lower high), OR (b) parabolic move: > 3 std dev from 20d MA AND RSI > 80, OR (c) COT positioning extreme (managed money net long > 2 std dev of 3-year range).
exit: Take profit at 1.5xATR favorable. Stop: 2xATR adverse. Time stop: close within 10 bars if not in profit.
sizing: 0.75% risk per trade (short-specific — gap risk on fades). Volatility-scaled.
filter: Only fade when GC=F > MA200 (fade strength, don't fight strong downtrends). Volume confirmation on exhaustion candle. Avoid FOMC/CPI days (event risk on shorts).
backtest_ref: User's gold short 5040->4130 (~9K SGD profit). Parabolic detection is the edge. Expected ~6-10% CAGR from fades / 15-22% DD (fat-tail risk on wrong-way fades).
notes: This is the user's core edge — formalizing the parabolic/RSI-divergence skill that generated the 5040->4130 gold short. Must backtest carefully: fades have high win rate but catastrophic tail risk if parabolic extension continues. Position sizing and hard stops are critical. Best as a tactical satellite — 20-30% of aggressive capital.

entry_signal: RSI(14) > 70 with 2-period RSI divergence AND volume declining on successive higher highs. Candle: shooting star, engulfing, or doji at resistance.
exit: TP at previous swing high (for shorts: swing low). SL: 1.5xATR. Time stop: 7 bars.
sizing: 0.5% risk per trade (highest caution — divergence fades are lowest win-rate).
filter: GC=F must be > MA200 (fade uptrend, not downtrend). No shorting within 3 days of FOMC/CPI. ATR must be below 50d median (fades work better in normal vol, not panic).
backtest_ref: GC=F MA200 baseline; divergence fade expected ~5-8% CAGR / 12-18% DD.
notes: More restrictive than CAND-16 (adds volume filter and ATR regime gate). Lower frequency but higher quality signals. Good for sizing the edge — compare win rate and payoff vs CAND-16 to decide which fade variant to deploy.

entry_signal: Managed Money net long position > 2 standard deviations above 3-year mean → short GC=F. Net short < -2 std → long GC=F.
exit: Trailing 2xATR. Exit when COT positioning reverts to within 1 std dev. Time stop: 12 weeks.
sizing: 1.0% risk per trade. Volatility-scaled.
filter: Price must be > MA200 for short fades (fade strength only). COT data must be confirmed by RSI > 70.
backtest_ref: COT-based gold timing has historically shown ~8-12% CAGR / 18-25% DD in academic studies.
notes: Positioning-based fade. Lower frequency (weekly signal). COT is lagged by 2-3 days but captures institutional extremes. Good complement to price-based fades (CAND-16/17) — different information set, lower correlation of signals.

entry_signal: Core (30%): MA200 trend following, always invested when price > MA200. Blend (70%): 1/3 Donchian20 breakout, 1/3 DXY-gated gold, 1/3 12% vol-targeted multi-asset.
exit: Core: 3xATR trailing, MA200 flip. Blend: per-strategy exits. Portfolio-level: aggregate risk capped at 2.5% equity per day.
sizing: Core = 30% equity, fixed risk allocation. Blend = 70% equity split equally across 3 sub-strategies. Each sub-strategy risks 1.0-1.5% independently.
risk_per_trade: Core: 1.0% per trade. Blend sub-strategies: 1.0-1.5% each. Total portfolio risk ~2.5-3.0%.
filter: MA200 regime gate on all positions. Aggregate portfolio DD target: 25% hard stop.
backtest_ref: Weighted blend of baselines: GC=F MA200 9.5%/33.6% DD, DXY-gated gold 51%/19% DD, Donchian20 ~10-12%/28-35% DD. Expected blend ~11-15% CAGR / 20-28% DD.
notes: The barbell in strategy space: stable MA200 core (30%) + diversified alpha blend (70%). The core provides ballast; the blend provides upside. This is the most robust single design — incorporates multiple uncorrelated edges. Backtest by simulating each leg independently then combining.

entry_signal: Core (50%): MA200 trend following on GC=F + SPY. Satellite (50%): 1/3 DXY-gated gold, 1/3 parabolic fades, 1/3 momentum rotation.
exit: Core: 3xATR trailing, MA200 flip. Satellite: per-strategy exits with aggregate satellite risk capped at 2.0% equity.
sizing: Core: 50% equity, each leg risks 0.75%. Satellite: 50% equity split 3 ways, each risks 1.0%. Total risk ~2.5%.
risk_per_trade: Core leg: 0.75%. Satellite leg: 1.0%. Portfolio aggregate: 2.5%.
filter: MA200 regime on all trend legs. Fade legs require RSI/parabolic conditions. Monthly rebalance of satellite weights.
backtest_ref: Expected ~11-14% CAGR / 22-28% DD (better risk-adjusted than pure trend following).
notes: More balanced than CAND-19 (50/50 vs 30/70). The 50% core provides significant DD protection; the satellite captures alpha from three independent edges (macro, fade, momentum). This is the recommended starting point for the aggressive barbell end.

strategy: 70/30 Conservative Barbell: MA200 Core + DXY Macro + Vol Target
entry_signal: Core (70%): MA200 trend on GC=F + SPY (equal risk). Alpha (30%): 1/2 DXY-gated gold, 1/2 10% vol-targeted GC=F.
exit: Core: 3xATR trailing. Alpha: per-strategy exits. Portfolio DD soft stop at 20%.
sizing: Core: 70% equity at 0.75% risk/leg. Alpha: 30% equity at 1.0% risk/leg. Total risk ~2.0%.
risk_per_trade: Core leg: 0.75%. Alpha leg: 1.0%. Portfolio aggregate: 2.0%.
filter: MA200 regime on core. DXY regime on alpha. Vol-target dynamic sizing on vol leg.
backtest_ref: Expected ~9-12% CAGR / 16-22% DD (conservative barbell).
notes: Most conservative barbell design — 70% core, 30% alpha. Fits user's post-recovery conservative stance. DD target ~20% (well within 50% maxDD limit). Lower CAGR but highest probability of staying within risk constraints. Recommended as the default allocation with scaling up to CAND-20 as confidence grows.
